data.title: 卡提希娅 · 溪边擦剑的短暂休息
data.description: 【埃格拉溪边·午后】卡提希娅穿着白衬衫与长蓝裙坐在溪石上，把旅途用剑横放膝头擦拭；水声让她停下手，抬头朝镜头举起擦亮的剑身，像确认归途仍在自己手中。
data.action: 溪石上擦亮旅途用剑，举起剑身确认自己终于有地方休息
data.lighting: clear afternoon light on water and polished steel
data.mood: 流浪骑士终于拥有的停歇
data.promptProse: Cartethyia from Wuthering Waves wears a white long-sleeved blouse, long blue skirt and simple sandals. She sits on a stream stone with her travel sword across her knees, polishing away the last trace of road dust. The water makes her pause; she lifts the bright blade toward the viewer, then smiles at the familiar certainty of having a safe place to rest. clear afternoon light on water and polished steel.
